limitations.case: First iPad source Workspace name-entry attempt
limitations.scope: After the first two characters in New Terminal, XCTest waited 60 seconds for the app event loop and the accessibility read timed out. The screenshot retained the unsubmitted form. The private server had no new session. A sample of the app showed UIKit hardware-keyboard availability and keyboard-window notifications on the main thread. The recovery used the directory-derived name.

The iPad showed the Agent More menu after a 65 s XCTest tap timeout. The subsequent visit dismissed the Search Agents keyboard before opening the same Agent. More, Changes then displayed the linked checkout, its exact branch and zero changed files.
The native Done banner was visible. After XCTest sent the touch, the detail remained empty and the source block had no size owner. A separately triggered real turn opened the intended terminal.
